name: downgit
description: Interactive CLI to download files and folders from GitHub repositories by URL

scripts.package: npm run build && pkg . --compress GZip --out-path build
scripts.package:win: npm run build && pkg . -t node22-win-x64 --compress GZip --output build/downgit.exe
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && pkg . -t node22-linux-x64 --compress GZip --output build/downgit-linux
scripts.package:macos: npm run build && pkg . -t node22-macos-x64 --compress GZip --output build/downgit-macos
